deterministic_donors_unaffected: r10's near and far donors are argmax/argmin of a similarity matrix and carry no draw noise. r19's 2.47x floor span runs between them and is unaffected by this round.
outcome_variable_scope: Own-minus-random-donor attribution against REAL HUMAN pairwise rankings, satisfaction from r04's tensor. Only the donor seed varies within a panel size.
scope: An estimate of the MAGNITUDE of donor-draw noise at the headline's panel size, measured with r04's judge configuration rather than r10's. r10 stores per-cell aggregates only, so its cells cannot be redrawn here. No number in this round is substituted into r10's cells and none of them replaces the headline's 7.9.
verdict: D DRAW-BOUND. The headline quotes 7.9 / 10.7, not the whole join, and that cell comes from r19 reading r10 -- which builds its random donor with EXACTLY the line r88 just measured, (i + 1 + rng.integers(0, n-1)) % n under seed 20260727, on its first 300 prompts. A third of the prompts carries MORE draw noise, not less. Measured on the identical panel with r04's tensor across 200 draws: sd 0.00948 at n=300, against 0.00535 at n=968. TRANSFERRING THAT TO THE HEADLINE'S CELL NEEDS AN ASSUMPTION THE DATA DOES NOT SETTLE, so both are given: under ABSOLUTE transfer it is 12% of the 0.079 the headline splits off; under PROPORTIONAL transfer, scaling by this round's own attribution level, 7%. Reporting one alone would repeat the path-dependent-decomposition error already logged here. Both say the same qualitative thing and neither is settled. SEPARATELY, the panel's MEAN attribution +0.1370 exceeds the whole join's +0.1252 by +0.0118. Judged on the RIGHT scale -- the standard error of a draw-averaged mean, 0.00077, not the single-draw sd, which would have called this an ordinary draw -- that is 15 standard errors, far too large to be a draw: it is COMPOSITION, and it is expected, because the release file is ordered by collection form and the first 300 prompts are the long-form head (entry 159). SEPARATED BEFORE THE RUN, so a null could not be read as a general acquittal: r10's NEAR and FAR donors are deterministic (argmax and argmin of a similarity matrix) and carry NO draw noise, so r19's 2.47x floor span -- the headline's structural claim that the floor is a CHOICE -- is untouched by anything here. Only the random-donor cell moves. THE FALSIFIABLE PREDICTION r88 implies, sd ~ 1/sqrt(n), anchored at n=968: worst deviation across three panel sizes is 11.5%, so it HOLDS at the 20% band -- which matters because it is the evidence that this noise is a property of the donor SAMPLING rather than of a particular judge. POSITIVE CONTROL: at n=968 this estimator gives 0.00535 against r88's 0.00550, a gap of -0.00016 against a standard error of 0.00044 -- consistent. SCOPE, AND IT IS THE POINT: r04's tensor is NOT r10's judge configuration, and r10 stores only per-cell aggregates, so its exact cells cannot be redrawn without GPU time. This is an ESTIMATE OF MAGNITUDE for the noise the floor carries. It is not substituted into r10's cells and no number here replaces 7.9.
